summary: Implemented the full frontend-backend integration plan: added backend requireBuyer middleware, POST /api/users/me, and saved-offers CRUD routes; built mobile API types, mappers, parseApiResponse, and data hooks; wired Offers, Saved, and Location screens to live API data; refactored SavedOffersProvider for server-backed saves with sign-in required to bookmark; added AuthSync for user provisioning on login. Verified new backend endpoints after restarting the server (4 locations, 2 offers for downtown-austin, 401 on protected routes without auth).
current_status: Backend and mobile app are connected for browsing offers/locations and authenticated saved-offer persistence. User should restart backend (bun run dev), ensure EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL points to the reachable host, and restart Expo to test sign-in, save, and saved-tab flows end-to-end.
